actions.action: Reserve space exclusively for critical history
actions.mechanism: Ordinary writes cannot consume the capacity needed for the bounded critical volume and its storage overhead.
actions.implementation: Partition the 20 MB quota into critical, metadata, and ordinary budgets. Reserve 2 MB for critical bytes plus worst-case framing overhead.
actions.check: Fill the ordinary budget, then inject the maximum critical volume over 30 minutes; verify every critical sequence survives.
actions.risk: Sizing must include encoding, indexes, and temporary writes.

actions.action: Replace exhausted ordinary detail with an explicit gap
actions.mechanism: Stopping ordinary capture at its budget produces one bounded, precisely described reduction interval rather than silently overwriting history.
actions.implementation: Assign ordinary sequence numbers before admission. Once full, retain only a reserved gap record containing first omitted sequence, last omitted sequence, and count.
actions.check: Replay a 30-minute outage; confirm retained ordinary records plus the declared gap account for every generated ordinary sequence.
actions.risk: Gap updates need crash-safe storage; counters must not overflow.

actions.action: Make replay identifiable and acknowledgments durable
actions.mechanism: Stable record identities distinguish retransmission from sequence gaps, while durable acknowledgments prevent premature local deletion.
actions.implementation: Persist an installation identifier and sequence namespace; deduplicate at the recipient. Delete local records only after acknowledgment of durable receipt.
actions.check: Interrupt acknowledgments and replay batches twice; verify duplicates are identified. Remove one critical record and verify its missing sequence is reported.
actions.risk: Persist a final sequence watermark to expose missing tails.

actions.mechanism: Allowlisted structured encoding excludes prohibited content; recovery tests establish usability rather than merely confirming stored bytes exist.
actions.implementation: Allow only bounded diagnostic codes, timestamps, and numeric fields. Use checksummed, crash-recoverable records; test decoding without consuming or deleting originals.
actions.check: Inject secret-bearing input and terminate during writes; confirm prohibited values are absent and every committed critical record recovers.
actions.risk: Do not acknowledge critical persistence before durable commit.
